title: Why Scientists Tipped FLIP Upright
titleSupport: Conditional title only if live Page composer provides field
description:
Scientists deliberately tipped this floating laboratory upright. FLIP’s deep hull reduced its response to surface waves so scientists could better measure the ocean. It could still drift and tilt.

Original schematic animation. AI-generated narration.
Sources: Scripps Institution of Oceanography (FLIP history and technical specifications); NOAA (surface-wave motion with depth); Dickey et al., 2012, doi:10.1029/2012JC007964.

#Magnivis #OceanScience #FLIP
firstComment:
Stable did not mean motionless: FLIP could still drift and tilt. Its design reduced its response to surface waves.
